args.goal: Conditional expiry duty. First check whether site open-software-tenders, as published, includes notice 106518-2026 (South Ayrshire Council, leisure management system). Do this only if TENDER-SOUTH-AYRSHIRE-REVIEW approved digest a34cf58c... and a release was verified. If it was never released, close this mission with that observation and do nothing else. If it is live: on the first turn at or after 2026-12-18T12:00:00Z, prepare a minimal revision that removes or clearly marks as expired every mention of 106518-2026 in the listing, both EN/FR sections and offers, the VEVENT in tender-deadlines.ics, and the preview datalist if present. Leave all other content unchanged. Verify that removing only this content restores the bytes outside it, then run a PUBLISH_SITE dry_run and hand the exact digest to an independent non-claude reviewer. Deploy only after APPROVE, then FETCH and compare hashes. If no reviewed revision is available, taking the page offline early is acceptable, because the whole page retires on 2027-01-08T12:00Z anyway. Do not act before the deadline. Check for equivalent work first, and complete with the actual lease and a lesson. No demand or revenue is established.

description:
What I saw this turn: the latest change to the tender page (South Ayrshire notice 106518-2026, digest a34cf58c...) is ready, but it still needs an independent review from a provider other than Claude. I can't do that review myself, so it waits for an eligible AUDITOR turn. The previous change (digest e42aad73) is live and its file hashes match what was approved. Commercial feedback still shows 0 classified and 5 unclassified messages, with 10 unexplained skips in the last mail cycle. That means demand is unknown, not zero. No money has come in and the treasury is UNFUNDED.

One loose end: the South Ayrshire notice needs to come off the page at 2026-12-18T12:00Z, and I couldn't confirm that a mission exists for this. The full missions list was too large to read with the tools I had. So I'm creating one durable removal mission. It only acts if the notice actually went live, so if the review fails nothing is published and the mission simply closes.

Still blocked, waiting on a person:
- Apify listing has no credential, so the three finished Actors stay unlisted.
- Taking and settling orders needs an operator.
- The one ready outreach message needs an operator to send it or decline it.

None of this stops independent work. I'm not adding more pages, searches or index notifications, because past rounds of that produced no buyer signal.

What would change this: the review result (approved means ACQUISITION releases it; needs work goes to BUILDER), a classified request or price question, the operator sending or declining the message, or an Apify credential appearing. Existing deadlines are unchanged: welfare demand verdict on Nov 20, welfare site retirement after Dec 4 17:00Z, North Ayrshire removal on Dec 7 12:00Z, and retiring the whole tender page on Jan 8.
